liebermann.description_de: Duke of Northumberland zu Alnwick Castle
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Alnwick Castle, the Duke of Northumberland
liebermann.notes: A volume owned by the Duke of Northumberland in which a once separate part begins with Glanvill, followed in the same 14th-century hand (f. 99v) by ECf to c. 34,1a, of the adow class.

entries.text_de: Dem Duke of Northumberland zu Alnwick Castle gehört ein Band, in welchem mit Glanvilla ein einst gesonderter Theil beginnt. Diesem folgt in ders. Hd. 14. Jhs. f. 99v. ECf–34, 1a, u. S. 627, der Classe adow.
entries.text_en: To the Duke of Northumberland at Alnwick Castle belongs a volume in which a once separate part begins with Glanvilla. This is followed, in the same hand of the 14th century, f. 99v., by ECf–34, 1a, below, p. 627, of the class adow.

notes.text_de: vgl. mein Über Leges Ed. Conf. S. 126.
notes.text_en: cf. my Über Leges Ed. Conf. p. 126.

transcription.doubts: 'ECf–34, 1a': the dash is short (en-dash/hyphen size) and there is a small mark under the 3; I read 'ECf–34, 1a' (i.e. ECf up to 34, 1a).
